title: Vampire Hunter
summary: Vampire Hunter was a mission assigned to Lok Lambert, Den Fears and Sophie Casterwill that consisted in putting Vlad Dracul's strongest Titan, the wild Antedeluvian, under control. However, unbeknownst to the Huntik Foundation, Tantras was already in the castle, trying to use the Heart of Vlad Dracul's power to open the Spiral Mark early.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Metz]] assigned this mission to Lok Lambert while [[Dante Vale]] was away in [[China]] training, putting him on charge. Upon entering the castle, Sophie notes that the [[Huntik Foundation|Foundation]] agents stationed there are missing, and shortly after the team run into [[Harrison Fears]], which prompts her to use [[Powerscan]] and detect a powerful evil [[magic]] surrounding the castle. Harrison makes use of his newly gained authority to make some [[Silent Soldiers]] (including the undercover [[Zhalia Moon]]) fight for him. In the midst of the brawl, Zhalia is able to hint to Sophie what the [[Blood Spiral|Spirals]] are up to, and that Harrison has gotten stronger. The Huntik team then try to hurry up, with Lok taking Harrison one-on-one, but he's outmatched and the situation doesn't look good for the Foundation. Lok asserts himself as the leader in this mission and confidently defeats the Soldiers by invoking [[Lindorm]], stalling Harrison in the process. 

The team quickly head to the throne room, where Tantras is found to be trying to use the Heart of Vlad Dracul to activate the Spiral Mark. However, Harrison quickly reappears and reveals he has already powerbonded to [[Antedeluvian]]. Lok, Sophie and Den struggle heavily against Powerbonded Antedeluvian, and are unable to stop Tantras' ritual by themselves, with Lok unsuccessfully attempting to invoke [[Pendragon]]. In the meanwhile, Dante has gotten wind of the news and uses [[Umbra]] to teleport to the castle and help his team. With the help of [[Ignatius]] and his newly learned spell [[Copykind]], Dante defeats Antedeluvian and distracts Tantras from his ritual, just about as Zhalia was about to blow her cover and invoke [[King Basilisk]] to stop him. Ultimately, the mission was unsuccessful, as the team couldn't subdue Antedeluvian. {{Source|Lok's Leadership}}

full_text:
Vampire Hunter was a mission assigned to Lok Lambert, Den Fears and Sophie Casterwill that consisted in putting Vlad Dracul's strongest Titan, the wild Antedeluvian, under control. However, unbeknownst to the Huntik Foundation, Tantras was already in the castle, trying to use the Heart of Vlad Dracul's power to open the Spiral Mark early.

History

Metz assigned this mission to Lok Lambert while Dante Vale was away in China training, putting him on charge. Upon entering the castle, Sophie notes that the Foundation agents stationed there are missing, and shortly after the team run into Harrison Fears, which prompts her to use Powerscan and detect a powerful evil magic surrounding the castle. Harrison makes use of his newly gained authority to make some Silent Soldiers (including the undercover Zhalia Moon) fight for him. In the midst of the brawl, Zhalia is able to hint to Sophie what the Spirals are up to, and that Harrison has gotten stronger. The Huntik team then try to hurry up, with Lok taking Harrison one-on-one, but he's outmatched and the situation doesn't look good for the Foundation. Lok asserts himself as the leader in this mission and confidently defeats the Soldiers by invoking Lindorm, stalling Harrison in the process.

The team quickly head to the throne room, where Tantras is found to be trying to use the Heart of Vlad Dracul to activate the Spiral Mark. However, Harrison quickly reappears and reveals he has already powerbonded to Antedeluvian. Lok, Sophie and Den struggle heavily against Powerbonded Antedeluvian, and are unable to stop Tantras' ritual by themselves, with Lok unsuccessfully attempting to invoke Pendragon. In the meanwhile, Dante has gotten wind of the news and uses Umbra to teleport to the castle and help his team. With the help of Ignatius and his newly learned spell Copykind, Dante defeats Antedeluvian and distracts Tantras from his ritual, just about as Zhalia was about to blow her cover and invoke King Basilisk to stop him. Ultimately, the mission was unsuccessful, as the team couldn't subdue Antedeluvian. [Lok's Leadership]

Trivia

• This is one of two known Huntik Foundation missions to not include Dante Vale as a team member, with the other one being The Piper of Hamlin (although he does help the team when after the mission goal shifts from subduing Antedeluvian to stopping Tantras).
